release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.5.6 — Complete Native Push Notification Engine & Scenario Triggers:
• Dual-Dispatch Push Pipeline: Direct Android NotificationManager dispatch + Expo notification channels guarantee instant heads-up banners on Android 10–14.
• Complete Scenario Coverage: Notifications fire for Parent PIN/Biometric overrides, restricted app barrier interception, study session start/completion/skips, quiz drill completions, rewards unlocks, and family pairing.
• Live In-App Notification Testers: Real-time 1-tap push notification test buttons added to both Student and Parent notification centers.
• Bi-Directional Family Pairing & Working /invite Portal: Instant local pairing with 0 404 errors.
